# Immutable B oracle

This is the exact `src` and `package.json` Git archive from accepted B commit
`37e3b1a64aedc921012fadb2b92668787d0fd3ac`, tree
`4eea90e4e35b9a69cf0afd3f1b6423477a98eb72`.

Do not edit these files or use them as a second maintained simulation path.
They exist solely as a frozen, independently verified correctness reference.
The research implementation shares its own explicit synchronous/cooperative
business source. No source-string rewriting generates resumable simulation.

`MANIFEST.json` pins all 284 source files and the original package file by
Git blob SHA-1, SHA-256 and byte length. The reference helper verifies the
complete original path set before loading. Local attributes preserve original
Git bytes even in Windows checkouts with automatic newline conversion.
